hypothesis: After an unusually quiet H1 volatility state, a close beyond a short frozen channel can either continue or mean-revert over the next few hours; the effect may differ by UTC liquidity block, weekday/weekend and direction.
derivation_disclosure: Independent intraday volatility/liquidity mechanism chosen after v15-v17 momentum failed temporal validation. No v15-v17 parameter or performance value defines this grid. Session tests v13-v14 are treated only as negative evidence against plain BTC range breaks; v18 requires prior volatility compression and tests three assets with account-level economics.
researcher_period_disclosure: The research program has already inspected data through 2024-12 in other mechanisms. V18 therefore uses 2021-2024 as development and reserves untouched 2025H1 as its first temporal validation; 2025H2 onward remains sealed holdout.

data_contract.input: independently checksummed Binance spot M1 aggregated to strict UTC H1
data_contract.signal_time: completed H1 close only; entry at next complete H1 open
data_contract.session_blocks: signal hour belongs to fixed 00-07, 08-15 or 16-23 UTC block
data_contract.day_group: weekday or weekend from signal timestamp
data_contract.proxy_limitation: No promotion until the matching native Ostium market passes coverage and price parity

execution_contract.compression: ATR14/close on the completed H1 bar immediately before the signal ranks at or below the registered quantile within its prior 168 or 336 complete H1 bars
execution_contract.channel: highest high / lowest low of the registered complete H1 bars ending one bar before the signal
execution_contract.breakout: long above prior channel high; short below prior channel low
execution_contract.fade: long below prior channel low; short above prior channel high
execution_contract.exit: gap-adverse ATR stop or close after the registered 2 or 6 H1 bars
execution_contract.position_policy: one open position per asset/candidate; overlapping signals ignored

stability.representative: graph medoid of largest stable component per categorical group without using performance metrics

small_account.leverage_rule: Use the highest venue leverage whose approximate liquidation distance remains at least 1.25 times the initial stop distance; reject if required collateral exceeds 35% of capital.
small_account.compounding_policy: Not used for selection; evaluate on constant 200 USDC first. Compound only after a candidate passes validation, parity and Monte Carlo sequence stress.

family_stop_rule.no_local_refinement_without: a stable component selected topologically and explicit derivation disclosure
family_stop_rule.sqcli_builder_only_after: development and independent validation both pass

sqcli_policy: No SQCLI Builder, OOS/holdout, paper or live until stable development, temporal validation, 200-USDC economics and native Ostium parity pass.
